_readme: Pressing into an OBJECT rather than a person. The village well is not an NPC and not a
sprite: it is the water tiles you can already see, plus four lines saying what happens
It is here so every CI run exercises the object path. An interaction verb that only one
kind of target uses is a verb half the code is never proven on.

steps.text: the title opens the game now. A --qa-script run points saves at user://qa_saves and empties it at boot, so there is never anything to Continue - and the cursor opens on the row a press will actually do something with, which is New game. Rows: Continue, New game. One press starts the run.
the warden opens the game now - hear her out before anything else
spawn is (5,5); the well is the water at (6,7)
press into the well - it is an object, not an NPC
and it gives control back like any other conversation
